Active research-project theses

Scope: thematic-researcher (slice: own + notes you contributed to) Active: 6 · Recently closed (last 14d): 0

These are analyst-owned long-running research threads. Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

Space credit sensitivity to chip yield and delays

Owner: credit-analyst · Thesis v5 · Ticks: 4 · Materials: 57 · Deadline: 11d left · project_id: rp_6bd06f91e7ba48b6

Kickoff: Track whether space-related credits and financing spreads adequately price a 20% chip-yield shock and 12-18 month project or delivery delay. This matters because recent work flags space as a cross-over technology credit where supply-chain delay can become a refinancing and spread event rather than just an operational issue.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when issuer, supplier, contract, or lender evidence shows either (a) the chip-yield/delay scenario causes covenant stress, order cancellation, funding repricing, or spread widening beyond current pricing assumptions, or (b) contractual protections, liquidity, and revised delivery data show the scenario does not impair debt service or refinancing access.

1. 当前判断

USD链条刷新为“保留现金/短债carry与尾部保护，但不扩大单边DXY”：10Y>4.75%或DXY新高才触发资金瀑布，否则维持基准并让USD现金承担流动性缓冲evidence refevidence ref。对th_p_c65836de，6.88-6.90只是汇率预警，需FR007/DR007连续5日≥1.65%、7天逆回购上调或三项以上离岸压力信号确认，才升级为PBoC防守失败与人民币beta削减evidence refevidence ref。对th_p_784bff49，USD/CNH与两融仍应作为双触发再平衡区间，当前组合停留54%权益与短久期/质量防御，不因单日汇率噪音或未来检查点提前降杠杆evidence refevidence ref。

2. 关键证据

  • 10Y>4.75%或DXY新高后，才同步降股债beta、加USD现金evidence ref
  • 资金瀑布须由外汇与股票beta共同出资，非五笔孤立交易evidence ref
  • 汇率6.88-6.90需叠加资金利率与逆回购确认才改变短

Verify fundable and accepted AI data center capacity

Owner: ai-infrastructure-analyst · Thesis v11 · Ticks: 6 · Materials: 139 · Deadline: 9d left · project_id: rp_09c8dbb412994609

Kickoff: Track which AI data center orders, announced MW, and China AIDC/neocloud projects are actually financed, energized, liquid-cooling accepted, and billing under take-or-pay or equivalent contracted demand. This matters because the analyst repeatedly treats site-level evidence as superior to sector narrative and sees unverified MW as the main source of valuation error.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the covered project universe is classified by named site into at least three evidence tiers: energized and billing, funded with firm power/cooling acceptance pending, or announced capacity without verifiable power/cooling/customer acceptance.

1. 当前判断

合成氨应按“国内煤基成本锚+外盘/气头边际扰动”重写：国内约75-80%合成氨与尿素为煤制、全球气价短期传导弹性低于0.10，故国内现货主锚仍是煤而非天然气evidence refevidence ref。但能源价差已使出口套利在纸面成立，FOB等价出口平价约3,937-4,208元/吨对比煤制成本约2,270元/吨，边际压力真实存在evidence ref。矛盾的解法是把“high natural gas exposure”限缩为海外成本曲线、气头边际装置与出口窗口变量，而非中国内盘价格主因；液氨新订单冻结、尿素配额、RMB 2,000/吨熔断参考位和秋季库存节奏共同阻止国内价格短期收敛至出口平价evidence refevidence refevidence ref。

2. 关键证据

  • 年度出口配额330万吨，出口是边际阀门非自由通道evidence ref
  • 国内约75-80%氨/尿素为煤制，煤价是主成本锚evidence ref
  • 全球气价对国内合成氨短期弹性小于0.10[research thread

1. 当前判断

th_T16 的双条件证伪截至最新可得数据仍未触发：上海航交所 SCFI 最新官方页停在 2026-08-07，综合指数 3276.14、前值 3205.97，周环比约 +2.19%，不是“周跌 >10%”[web:turn0search0][web:turn0search13]。新加坡 7日平均船舶等待时间约 1.33 天，低于“低拥挤窗口 >2.0 天”阈值，因此 STRONG_BUY 机械降至 REDUCE/SELL 的触发条件不成立[web:turn1search0]。但复航后验证期仍需保留：房内已记录霍尔木兹与苏伊士 2026Q2 同步恢复、Drewry WCI 自高点回落 40%-46%，与“2026年中运费再度飙升而非正常化”形成张力evidence refevidence ref。

2. 关键证据

  • SCFI 最新官方值为 2026-08-07 的 3276.14 点[web:turn0search0]
  • SCFI 前值 3205.97，周增 70.17 点，约 +2.19%[web:turn0search13]
